headline: NGCP puts Visayas grid on red alert again
summary: The National Grid Corp. of the Philippines raised another red alert for the Visayas grid, warning of possible power interruptions on Monday from 5 p.m. to 6 p.m. Supply remains persistently thin, according to the advisory.
why: Power supply shortages disrupt manufacturing, commerce and households, and they affect the reliability of the country's electricity system. Grid constraints also shape investment in generation capacity.
